decisions.action: Keep the installed Dallisgrass species name and its 1804 Poiret authorship; no canonical rename.
Keep installed Vaseygrass separately accepted (1853 Steudel); never collapse into Dallisgrass based on old varieties or similar photos.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum dilatatum var. dilatatum; P. dilatatum var. chiru Millot ex P.R.Speranza & G.H.Rua; P. dilatatum var. uruguaianense I.L.Barreto ex Valls & G.H.Rua
decisions.action: WCVP recognizes exactly three varieties. chiru and uruguaianense were formally published in 2022; preserve species-rank learner, do not assign a variety to Texas photographs without specimens.

decisions.source_name: Digitaria dilatata (Poir.) Coste; Paspalum moluccanum Huber
decisions.action: These names are same-type synonyms of accepted Dallisgrass; P. moluccanum is illegitimate superfluous. Do not create duplicate cards.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum dilatatum var. decumbens Vasey; P. dilatatum var. sacchariferum Arechav.
decisions.action: These historical Dallisgrass varieties resolve to accepted var. dilatatum, not separate accepted varieties.
Despite dilatatum in the original combination, this 1877 name is a heterotypic synonym of separately accepted Vaseygrass; do not attach to Dallisgrass records by epithet alone.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum dilatatum subsp. flavescens Roseng., B.R.Arrill. & Izag.
decisions.accepted_name: Paspalum flavescens (Roseng., B.R.Arrill. & Izag.) P.R.Speranza & G.H.Rua
decisions.action: The 2022 Dilatata-group revision elevated this historical subspecies to a separate accepted species. Do not merge old flavescens specimens into P. dilatatum sensu stricto without concept review; no new learner installation.
The old variety maps to separately accepted P. pauciciliatum, not any of the three currently accepted P. dilatatum varieties.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum ovatum Nees ex Trin.; Paspalum ovatum var. parviflorum Nees
decisions.accepted_name: Paspalum dilatatum var. dilatatum (species name); Paspalum urvillei Steud. (var. parviflorum)
decisions.action: P. ovatum is an illegitimate superfluous synonym of Dallisgrass var. dilatatum; P. ovatum var. parviflorum is instead synonymized with Vaseygrass. Preserve full author/rank on legacy records.

decisions.source_name: Rosso et al. 2022 New Entities of Paspalum and a Synopsis of the Dilatata Group
decisions.accepted_name: Paspalum dilatatum Poir. and separate Dilatata-group species
decisions.action: Primary systematic revision recognizes eight species and three P. dilatatum varieties in the complex, including distinct P. plurinerve, P. vacarianum, P. flavescens and P. torrense; supports name/rank boundaries but does not genotype any Texas specimen or prove individual hybrid ancestry.

decisions.source_name: Paspalum dilatatum / Paspalum urvillei learner photographs, variety/cytotype and hybrid claims
decisions.action: Preserve existing species-card identity, image, and any hybrid/cytotype/variety holds. Nomenclatural PASS is not proof of an image's species or of a plant's ploidy/hybrid lineage; no photo reassignment or field-ID edit. Historical records labelled P. dilatatum sensu lato may require specimen-level reassessment.

conflict_and_hold_summary.accepted_names: PASS both species accepted, no rename
conflict_and_hold_summary.accepted_varieties: PASS three P. dilatatum varieties, not assigned to Texas photos

references.authority: Rosso V.C., Valls J.F.M., Quarin C.L., Speranza P.R., Rua G.H. 2022, Systematic Botany 47(1):125–139
references.note: Primary revision abstract and nomenclature cross-checked with POWO; full publisher article not directly accessible

handoff: Preserve existing canonical cards and identities. Historic dilatatum-variety names may belong to separately accepted Paspalum taxa; check author and rank before alias reconciliation. No new cards, photographs, genus lessons or native-range decisions.
